baslik: Chapter I: The Great Dollar Rush, 1994

olaylar.soz: Line up, line up, one by one,

bilgi: Moody's and Standard & Poor's cut Türkiye's credit rating. The rush to the dollar begins.

olaylar.soz: Everybody wants a dollar, run, run, run!

bilgi: About 14,500 lira at New Year. About 39,900 lira on 6 April.

olaylar.soz: Look how fast the numbers fly!
Up, up, up goes the dollar!
Down, down, down goes the lira!
Up, up, up goes the dollar!

bilgi: They peaked near 700%. Central Bank reserves fell from $6.3 billion to $3.3 billion.
A stabilization package: a large devaluation, higher prices for state goods, new taxes and spending cuts.

olaylar.soz: Up, up, up goes the dollar!
Down, down, down goes the lira!

bilgi: Three banks closed. The economy shrank by about 6% and inflation rose above 100%.
